description: This source file defines a class 'Averages' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the Calculation\Statistical namespace. It provides various static methods for calculating statistical averages and other related functions such as median and mode on data inputs, including handling errors and different data types.

classes.name: Averages
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating various statistical averages (mean, median, mode, deviations) including error handling.

methods.name: averageDeviations
methods.description: Calculates the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the arithmetic mean of the provided data values.

methods.name: averageA
methods.description: Calculates the average including logical TRUE/FALSE and text values as zero or one.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates the median value of the provided data set.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Finds the most frequently occurring value in the provided data set.
